translations.web: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.
translations.bsb: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came and tested Jesus by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.
translations.kjv: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
